_comment: Tracker for unmerged PRs that this hub's setup depends on or cares about. Each entry: id (owner/repo#n or owner/branch), title, repo, state (open|merged|closed|superseded), depends (plugin ids it backs), reaply (short re-apply note after hermes update if dropped). CI lint verifies: valid JSON, every plugins.json tracked_by_prs[].id exists here, and 'state' is one of the allowed values.

prs.title: Add footer hook (LLM response footer injection)
prs.reapply: Pull PR diff and apply to local core before enabling quota footer: gh pr diff <n> | git -C <core> apply

prs.title: Add usage_extra hook (per-provider usage stats injection)
prs.reapply: Pull PR diff and apply to local core before enabling quota usage_extra: gh pr diff <n> | git -C <core> apply
